verdict.rationale: Portkey documents that it has open-sourced its AI gateway, the routing core, and that it can be run locally with a single command (npx @portkey-ai/gateway). That is a direct self-host path for the gateway. The evidence does not show that the broader platform (logs/observability, model catalog, budgets, guardrails, prompt management) can be self-hosted, and those features appear to sit on Portkey's hosted service at api.portkey.ai. Missing for 10: self-hosting of the full platform beyond the gateway, production deployment docs (Docker/Kubernetes/on-prem), independent or hands-on corroboration of self-hosted operation.
